# `adt dataelement`

ABAP data element operations

```bash
adt dataelement [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                    | Description                               |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `adt dataelement create`   | Create a new ABAP data element            |
| `adt dataelement read`     | Read source code of an ABAP data element  |
| `adt dataelement activate` | Activate one or more ABAP data element(s) |
| `adt dataelement delete`   | Delete an ABAP data element               |

## `adt dataelement create`

Create a new ABAP data element

```bash
adt dataelement create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | data element name |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                         | Default |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number            |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if data element already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                      |         |

## `adt dataelement read`

Read source code of an ABAP data element

```bash
adt dataelement read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description       | Default |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | data element name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt dataelement activate`

Activate one or more ABAP data element(s)

```bash
adt dataelement activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description          | Default |
| ------------ | -------------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | data element name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt dataelement delete`

Delete an ABAP data element

```bash
adt dataelement delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description       | Default |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | data element name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
